Payout of 31 July is short ₹2,467.14.
The bank credited ₹8,99,589.01 against an expected ₹9,02,056.15. 32 orders sit in this payout. 2 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
